Underlying: the E-mini S&P 500 continuous future with extended market hours, open-interest data mapping, backwards-ratio normalization and contract depth offset 0, filtered to expiries between 0 and 182 days. Options: future options on that underlying filtered with the call spread filter using parameters 5, 5 and -5 written as a lambda. Rules on each slice while not invested: create the canonical option symbol for the mapped future, read its chain from the slice, require at least two contracts, take the earliest expiry, the lowest strike as the in-the-money leg and the highest as the out-of-the-money leg, and buy one bull call spread through the OptionStrategies helper. Compliance: defined-risk long spread only, one position at a time, use the strategy abstraction rather than manual legs, snake_case API per our style guide, type annotations, comment the canonical-symbol step.
author: aaditya

template: Future options: bull call spread on E-mini S&P 500 futures
prompt: QuantConnect Python, snake_case. initialize: set_start_date(2024, 9, 1), set_end_date(2024, 12, 31), underlying = add_future(Futures.Indices.SP_500_E_MINI, extended_market_hours=True, data_mapping_mode=DataMappingMode.OPEN_INTEREST, data_normalization_mode=DataNormalizationMode.BACKWARDS_RATIO, contract_depth_offset=0), underlying.set_filter(0, 182), add_future_option(underlying, lambda u: u.call_spread(5, 5, -5)). on_data(slice): return if portfolio.invested; symbol = Symbol.create_canonical_option(underlying.mapped); chain = slice.option_chains.get(symbol); return if not chain or len(list(chain)) < 2; expiry = min(x.expiry for x in chain); sorted_by_strike = sorted(x.strike for x in chain); itm_strike = sorted_by_strike[0]; otm_strike = sorted_by_strike[-1]; option_strategy = OptionStrategies.bull_call_spread(symbol, itm_strike, otm_strike, expiry); buy(option_strategy, 1).
